reviews.review: The negative reviews are just from reviewbombing
amazing concept to game play pacing. just wish theres coop

I’ve put 132 hours into this and it still pulls me back in.

On the surface it looks goofy, but underneath there’s a genuinely tense and addictive extraction loop. Loot runs are stressful in a good way, deaths hurt, and progression feels earned.

Not for everyone, it can be punishing and a bit janky at times, but if you like Tarkov-style risk/reward without the hyper-realism, this absolutely slaps.

Good game, lots of hours and multiple possible runs for a cheap price. Their is problems in this games modding world right now, but you dont need mods to play this game. If you are desuaded by the negative reviews about this. You dont need to download mods.   very much worth the purchase

10/10 – Came for a quick run, stayed because a duck with better aim than me erased my entire existence.
Loot is great, tension is real, and every corner whispers "quack"

I've always wanted an extraction shooter without the PvP. This scratches every itch I've ever wanted; could not recommend this game enough, especially for the price! If you're on the fence about getting it, you absolutely should :D

An awesome looter shooter with an addictive gameplay loop, clean and legible graphics, made only better by completely avoiding multiplayer and letting you enjoy the game at your own pace. I love how everything is balanced across different difficulty settings and how it still offers challenging moments at any of them. The quests become a bit stale and repetitive towards the end, but in general the game is great and all the small shortcomings can be patched through steam workshop addons. I just wish it had joypad support as I'm not much of a keyboard/mouse player and got really precise over the years with analog stick aiming. But I hope it will be eventually added.

10/10
Can't stop playing (Only achieved Ending 0 so far, but aiming for 100%). Haven't tried any mods, I can see that towards the end, seeing bosses on the map could help with farming/doing missions. 99% gameplay, the rest is having to fast forward time because of a storm and inventory management, which is slightly inconvenient. Entertaining and thrilling, especially when your inventory is full and you're surrounded. Kind of needs a guide so that you can tell what items you will need to keep for the future.

For the price, it’s a good game, imo, even though my enjoyment went downhill after the Farm Town region because of the ridiculous RNG grind that blocks your progress, poorly designed quests that require you to do the same thing multiple times, or delivering random types of garbage you sold long ago due to limited inventory space at your base. The introduction of unnecessary mechanics that slow you down even more (as if the RNG grind wasn’t enough) wasn’t helpful either. Still, even if you don’t complete the game, I think it’s worth playing for the price.
Very addictive, can't put it down.

TL:DR the game is fun and has plenty of potential especially for the price. If you like Tarkov or Zero Sievert you might enjoy this one.

If you like the extraction shooter style game but want something single player and a bit on the joke side, this is a good game for that. It has various difficulty settings so it can be challenging OR you can turn it down and it can be a lot easier to  just mess around with. The graphics are in a fun style for this game, the sound isn't bad though can get a bit repetitive, the gameplay again can be hard or easier if you want. Most of the game play loop is interesting enough and they currently have quite a few quests to keep you going for much of the game.

As always, just because you like something doesn't mean you don't have a few criticisms of it and want it to be great. Here are a few of my suggestions for game play/UI/etc. that I think would improve the game some. Yes there are also a LOT of mods for the game already but I feel that most things should come from the devs themselves if you want the game to be great without additions outside help.
***UI stuff***
- be able to turn off tool tips, they get in the way a lot of the time when you are looking through inventory
- tabs for melee weapons to keep them from cluttering up the weapons tab (especially with "tools")
-larger menu size for when selling/dismanteling things so you don't have to scroll so often. Also multi click or have a container to put things to do it all at once instead of needing to click on everything individually.

***QOL***
- containers for different items to help sort them (ammo, meds, etc.) the inventory is quite large but it gets cluttered quickly, it might be better to have designated space to store the things you will get TONS of at some point. Even if its expensive have containers for these things so you can deal with the inventory clutter.

***game play***
- more quests, more things to keep you interested and going back out on the raids
- more things to build with the nonsense you collect in the raids, be creative and silly, just give me a reason to keep getting junk to make my duck base useful and cool

***other***
- there isn't a quest to guide you to beat JLabs, there should probably be something there to point to the boss like there is with the other ones.
- more maps with different items to get. Put certain things on certain maps or in a bit more guided like with the PC parts. 
- along with saying more maps I think they should split the bosses from Farm Town to other places. The ramp up in bosses and hard enemies goes from somewhat challenging to absurd when you get to Farm Town, its too much on one map, more maps would be nice in general but also somewhere different to put the Farm Town bosses instead of just a single map like that. It would give you more of a reason to go other places and they could make for specific item gathering (or better chance).
- sniper riffles should do a lot more damage in general. The way they are now makes them just frustrating to use because of their reload times between shots, the recoil, and honestly you can get almost as much damage from the M1A and its far quicker/easier to use. Give me a decent reason to carry around the heavy sniper riffles, let me sneak while picking off enemies from a HUGE distance, something that makes them a viable option outside of the quests needing to use them.

Other about the game for now.
The mods out there make some big changes, they do sometimes fix all the things I mentioned (but not the base game so its not quite the same). 
-1st/3rd person changes the game fully and I found I prefer playing in 3rd person because of the view distance, or limited view distance in overhead mode
-containers make sorting and looting a bit less of a pain
-quest/boss marking is nice QOL
-item value and inventory amount is good for looting

Again all in all its a fun game and well worth the price. I can see they are adding more already and I hope they keep doing so to give it even more content to play through for this game.
Amazing game, best extraction shooter I've played and this is what pulled me away from Arc Raiders.  Duckov is superior in every way.  We need more single player extraction shooters.
